name: canvas
description: Read and edit flows in open Canvas projects and manage assistant packages through the running desktop app.

interface.longDescription: Explore open Canvas projects and build flows with text and assistant nodes, positions, and typed connections. Edit existing node text and positions without running assistants. Create assistant packages from instructions and skills, export installed assistants as .flowast files, and remove personal packages when requested. Canvas must be running on the same Windows computer with MCP enabled at its fixed local endpoint. The connection cannot execute assistants, generate media, or return original asset files. No manual client configuration is required.
defaultPrompt: Summarize the active project in Canvas.
Create a text-to-assistant flow in the active Canvas project.
Explain the connections between nodes in my Canvas project.
Which agent definitions are available in Canvas?
